name: GlassAccordion

stories.notes: Template stories Default + Variants (Variants renders same single accordion); docs text is placeholder 'A glass morphism glassaccordion component.'

tests.notes: Template smoke/axe tests render <GlassAccordion /> with NO items, so axe runs on an empty container; toggling/keyboard never exercised.

material_impl: OptimizedGlass per item (elevation level1, intensity medium) but every item then overrides material inline with hard-coded rgba background (0.05/0.018), border rgba(255,255,255,0.15) and box-shadow (lines 368-377), so the shared primitive is effectively bypassed. Text colors hard-coded fallbacks rgba(248,250,252,0.96). No tokens beyond --glass-theme-text and --glass-motion-easing-standard.
motion: Custom height animation via setTimeout/rAF measuring scrollHeight (473-507). Reduced motion IS wired via useMotionPreferenceContext + respectMotionPreference (144-146). Chevron rotation relies on class 'rotate-180' which does not exist in the library CSS (rg finds no .rotate-180 rule) so the chevron never rotates; if consumer Tailwind supplies it, the collapse icon carries rotate-180 AND its wrapper adds rotate-180 (302, 429) => net 360deg, chevron points down when open.
a11y: Wrong pattern: role=tablist/tab/tabpanel (338, 401, 446) instead of disclosure buttons + region; aria-multiselectable on tablist. aria-labelledby points at 'accordion-trigger-<id>' but the button has no id (400-447) => broken labelling. Focus helpers use global document.querySelector on data-accordion-trigger (223-254) so two accordions with same item ids steal focus across instances. Collapsed panels are height:0 overflow hidden but not hidden/inert, so focusable content inside closed panels stays in tab order. Trigger min-height 44/48 good.
api: forwardRef yes, className/style passthrough, controlled/uncontrolled value/defaultValue, but data-driven items[] only (no compound Accordion.Item/Trigger/Content), no asChild, value type flips string vs string[] by `multiple`. compact/contained/maxHeight props are layout hacks for docs previews.
ssr: 'use client'; document access only in event handlers. OK.
target: Single compound Accordion (Root/Item/Trigger/Content) on a shared disclosure primitive; absorb GlassAccordionUI
justification: Accordion is a core primitive that must be flawless; this one uses tab semantics, has broken aria-labelledby, cross-instance focus via document.querySelector, a non-rotating (or double-rotating) chevron and inline rgba that overrides the glass primitive. Two accordions exist in the library. Rebuild once as a compound disclosure component with correct WAI-ARIA, scoped focus, inert closed panels and token-driven material, then retire GlassAccordionUI.

name: GlassAlert (+ GlassAlertTitle, GlassAlertDescription, GlassAlertActions; aliases Alert/AlertTitle/...)
material_impl: Uses OptimizedGlass with intent mapping (success/warning/danger) - one of the cleaner uses of the shared primitive. 'info' maps to neutral intent (141-142) so info has no visual identity. Exposes raw primitive knobs (blur, animation 'morph/ripple/wave', border 'neon/particle', lighting 'caustic/iridescent', intensity 'ultra') - leaking the material engine into a feedback component.
motion: Motion preset slideUp; reduced motion wired via useMotionPreferenceContext (114-117). Dismiss is instant (no exit animation).
a11y: role=alert combined with aria-live=polite default (193-195) - contradictory (alert is implicitly assertive); every static inline alert announces on mount. Dismiss button labelled. Title is hard-coded <h5> (251) regardless of document outline. ContrastGuard/TextWithContrast imported but unused.
api: forwardRef; className passthrough; variant includes both 'error' and 'destructive' synonyms; dismiss is uncontrolled only (internal dismissed state, no open prop). Compound parts exist. Ref goes to OptimizedGlass but when animated the outer element is Motion wrapper, so className lands on inner element.
fake_complexity: None, but prop surface (lighting=caustic, border=particle) promises effects irrelevant to an alert.
justification: Structurally reasonable compound alert on the shared primitive. Needs: correct live-region semantics (role=status for non-urgent, alert only for errors), distinct info intent, controlled open + exit motion, configurable heading level, and removal of the leaked material-engine props. GlassErrorState should become an Alert recipe rather than a separate component.

name: GlassAnimatedNumber (+ GlassAnimatedCounter, GlassAnimatedStat, useAnimatedNumber)

stories.notes: Best story coverage in shard (Sizes, Variants, InteractiveDemo, DashboardExample).

material_impl: Wraps the bare number in an OptimizedGlass pill with inline hard-coded border rgba(148,163,184,0.18) and triple box-shadow (204-211). A number should be typography, not a glass chip; GlassAnimatedStat additionally wraps the label text in its own OptimizedGlass (315-321), producing glass-on-glass blobs around plain text.
motion: Custom rAF tween with 4 easings. Reduced motion NOT handled: useReducedMotion is imported but never called (16), and respectMotionPreference is declared in props (46) but not destructured, so it leaks via ...props onto OptimizedGlass/DOM. useAnimatedNumber hook has no rAF cancel on unmount (368-387).
a11y: aria-label on a generic div without role; no aria-live, and every intermediate frame value is rendered as text so screen readers reading on change get noise. No final-value-only accessible text.
api: forwardRef via useImperativeHandle; className only (no style passthrough beyond spread); formatter/prefix/suffix good, but no Intl.NumberFormat/locale (manual regex comma). Compound helpers are React.FC without forwardRef/className consistency.
ssr: 'use client'; SSR renders `from` value (0) then animates - hydration-safe but shows 0 on first paint.
target: Unstyled-by-default AnimatedNumber (typography only, Intl.NumberFormat, reduced-motion, aria-live final value) consumed by a single Metric/Stat component
justification: Counting numbers are a premium-feel detail, but this implementation puts a glass box around text, ignores reduced motion despite importing the hook, leaks a prop to the DOM, and lacks locale formatting. Redesign as a pure typographic primitive and fold Counter/Stat into the metric family.

name: GlassAvatar (+ GlassAvatarGroup, GlassAvatarFallback)
material_impl: OptimizedGlass plus Tailwind-ish 'glass-backdrop-blur-md bg-white/10 glass-border-white/20' (229) layered on top -> double blur/background; sizes/radius duplicated as both classes and inline styles (107-143). Variant literally named 'glass-radius-md' (18) - a CSS class name leaked into the public API.
motion: Loading spinner glass-animate-spin with no reduced-motion handling.
a11y: Outer OptimizedGlass role=img with aria-label AND inner => double announcement. Status dot uses role=status (287) - a live region per avatar. Status conveyed only by color.
api: forwardRef targets the , which is absent when showing fallback -> ref null. elevation typed 1|2|3 but default is 'level1' string (90) and AvatarGroup passes 'level2' (345) -> both silently fall to level1. className applied to wrapper AND inner glass (198, 230). isLoading not reset when src changes. AvatarGroup spacing classes '-glass-gap-1' are nonexistent; actual overlap via inline margins.
duplicates: src/components/interactive/GlassAvatarGroup.tsx (root export GlassAvatarGroup at src/index.ts:403 is the interactive one; this file's GlassAvatarGroup is shadowed)
target: Compound Avatar (Root/Image/Fallback/Status) + single AvatarGroup; delete duplicate in interactive/
justification: Typing is internally contradictory (elevation), the public variant name is a CSS class, the ref disappears in fallback state, and a11y double-announces. Two AvatarGroups exist. Rebuild as a small compound primitive with Radix-style image loading status.

name: GlassBadge (+ StatusBadge, CountBadge, BadgeGroup)
material_impl: Each badge is a full OptimizedGlass (backdrop-filter per badge). All nine variants map to essentially the same class 'glass-border glass-border-black/10' (133-143) - a class not defined in library CSS - so success/warning/error badges are visually identical neutral pills. Dot colors use shadcn tokens bg-primary/bg-success/bg-destructive (145-155) that only partially exist via a [data-glass-component] compat shim in src/styles/glass.css.
motion: Motion preset on mount; reduced motion wired. Runtime-built Tailwind arbitrary class `duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.fast}ms]` (219) can never be compiled.
a11y: Every badge is role=status (188, 225) => live-region spam in lists. Removable badge sets role=button on the container AND nests a GlassButton => nested interactive. aria-label `Badge: ${children}` stringifies ReactNode children to '[object Object]' for non-string content (227). Remove button sized to icon (12-16px) - fails touch target.
api: forwardRef (cast as any to OptimizedGlass); variant typed as open string; shape option literally 'glass-radius-md' (40). Helpers inconsistent.
fake_complexity: Semantic variants are fake - they do not change appearance.
target: One Badge primitive (non-interactive, tokenized tone scale, no backdrop-filter) + Tag/Chip for interactive; fold BadgeLine/BadgeCluster/StatusBadge into it
justification: A badge that renders all semantic tones identically and is a live region is broken at the most basic level. Per-badge backdrop-filter is wasteful for a 20px label. Redesign as a cheap, tokenized tone badge; interactive/removable behavior belongs to Chip.

name: GlassBadgeLine
material_impl: Pure Tailwind classes bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 bg-amber-500/15 bg-red-500/15 (52-58) - none defined in library CSS (rg count 0), so without consumer Tailwind every intent renders identically unstyled. No glass primitive.
a11y: role=list/listitem OK; aria-label per item overrides visible text with 'success badge: X' - acceptable.
api: forwardRef; items[] only; 'danger' vs Badge 'error' naming inconsistency; index keys.
fake_complexity: Intent styling is non-functional in the shipped CSS.
target: Badge group pattern (BadgeGroup) in redesigned Badge
justification: A 73-line map over Tailwind classes the library does not ship. It is a strict subset of BadgeGroup and LiquidGlassBadgeCluster. Remove (or keep a deprecated alias to the consolidated Badge group for one major).

name: GlassChip (+ GlassChipGroup)

tests.notes: Template tests; no selection/removal behavior tests.

material_impl: OptimizedGlass with liftOnHover/press plus extra 'glass-backdrop-blur-md' class. All nine variants map to the same 'glass-border-black/10' class (124-170, undefined in CSS) - comment admits shell stays neutral. Forces --glass-theme-text to dark slate rgba(15,23,42,0.92) inline (301) - unreadable on dark surfaces, theme-hostile.
motion: Motion scaleIn wrapper; useMotionPreference wired. Hover-scale classes glass-hover-scale-105 / active:scale-95. GlassChipGroup wraps each chip in a second Motion (slideIn, 50ms stagger) so each chip animates twice.
a11y: role=checkbox when onSelect, role=button when clickable, otherwise role=status (308) - static chips become live regions. GroupChip single-selection still uses checkbox semantics (should be radio). Remove <button> nested inside role=checkbox/button container => nested interactive. Remove button 20x20px (249). Default chip tabIndex=-1.
api: forwardRef; controlled selected; group supports controlled/uncontrolled. Plays UI sounds (useGlassSound) on click/select/remove by default (180-194) - surprising side effect for a design-system chip.
ssr: 'use client'; sound util presumably lazily creates AudioContext (not verified).
target: Chip/Tag (interactive: filter, input, choice) with ChipGroup using radio/checkbox group semantics; absorbs removable Badge
justification: Chips are high-frequency surfaces; this one has fake variants, forced dark text, nested interactive controls, wrong ARIA for single-select, sub-minimum remove target and default sound effects. Redesign into a proper filter/choice chip family with tokenized selected state.

name: GlassDataGrid

tests.notes: Includes real keyboard sort tests (Enter/Space, non-sortable).

material_impl: OptimizedGlass container + CSS module using --aura-* tokens and color-mix (module.css:15-170) - the most token-disciplined styling in this shard. Remaining hard-codes are fallbacks only.
motion: CSS transitions on row/header with token durations; no reduced-motion override in module CSS (transitions are short).
a11y: Native table with columnheader + aria-sort, sortable headers tabbable with Enter/Space (203-211, 326-347). aria-label 'Column X' overrides visible header text unnecessarily. Drag handles are role=button tabIndex=0 but do nothing (see fake_complexity) - focusable dead controls.
api: forwardRef; className/style; tri-state sort; columns accept key/id/header/label/accessorKey/cellRenderer/render (multiple synonyms) - API sprawl. initialSort only (no controlled sort).
fake_complexity: enableRowDragging and sort-indicator spring are fake: useDraggableListPhysics and useVectorSpring are inline stubs returning empty handlers/styles (66-77), so drag handles render but reordering never happens and onRowOrderChange is never called; 'perspective: 1000px' (280) is leftover.
target: Single GlassTable/DataTable (headless sort/filter/selection + optional virtualization); reuse this file's CSS-module token approach
justification: Clean token-based CSS and decent keyboard sort, but it ships a fake drag-reorder feature with stub physics hooks and duplicates at least five other table implementations. Its styling approach should be the template for the consolidated table; the component itself should be merged.

name: GlassDataGridPro
material_impl: None of its own; delegates to GlassDataTable.
a11y: Wraps table in role=region div; otherwise inherits DataTable issues.
api: Different prop names than DataTable (rows vs data, density vs size). `grouping` prop declared (22) but never used; density 'spacious' ignored; ref goes to wrapper div.
ssr: Inherits DataTable's heavy imports of the advanced/* 'consciousness' modules.
fake_complexity: 'Pro' is a name only - source comment: 'Lightweight wrapper around GlassDataTable; placeholder for advanced features' (29). Grouping not implemented.
justification: A placeholder that advertises Pro features (grouping) it does not implement, with a divergent prop vocabulary. Remove; provide a codemod/alias to the consolidated table.

name: GlassDataTable (+ ConsciousGlassDataTable, PredictiveDataTable, GazeResponsiveDataTable, AccessibleDataTable, DataTableConsciousnessPresets)

stories.notes: Placeholder docs; no stories for selection, loading, empty, sticky header or consciousness variants.

tests.notes: Some real behavior tests (mobile rows, sorting, selection, pagination states).

material_impl: OptimizedGlass + createGlassStyle, then overridden inline with hard-coded gradient rgba(255,255,255,0.05->0.018), shadows and borderColor (732-746); controls styled by inline tableControlStyle constants with hard-coded rgba and an SF Pro font stack (34-50). thead uses both bg-muted/20 class and inline rgba (853-856). Three competing material sources.
motion: Reduced motion via useReducedMotion gates transition classes, but those classes are runtime-built Tailwind arbitrary values `duration-[${...}ms]` (729, 895, 1042) that cannot exist in CSS. 'animate-pulse' applied to all rows when a predicted sort column exists (1056-1062).
a11y: Desktop sortable <th> are click-only: no tabIndex, no button, no key handler (882-910) - keyboard users cannot sort (DataGrid gets this right). aria-sort='none' set on non-sortable columns. Mobile card rows clickable divs without role/keyboard (775-790). Checkbox accent hard-coded slate (868) - near invisible on dark glass. Mobile stacked dl layout is a genuine good idea.
api: Generic typed columns (accessorKey/accessorFn/cell) - decent. But GlassDataTable wrapper (218-222) is a plain function that spreads props into the forwardRef inner; with React 18.2 (package.json:471) `ref` is stripped from props, so ref never reaches the DOM. Default getRowId uses index, so selection breaks across pages/sorting. Sort/filter/pagination/search are uncontrolled only; filterable has no UI. Default searchable=true and pagination=true.
ssr: 'use client'. Statically imports five 'advanced' modules (~6,150 lines, framer-motion) - GlassPredictiveEngine, GlassAchievementSystem, GlassBiometricAdaptation, GlassEyeTracking, GlassSpatialAudio (12-19) - into every table bundle. Hooks are called conditionally (302-310) violating Rules of Hooks; toggling a feature prop at runtime corrupts hook order.
fake_complexity: Severe. 'Eye tracking' handler is never attached - subscription lines are commented out (430-437). 'Biometric' adaptation changes page size from a stress level derived from mouse-movement heuristics; outside its provider the default context returns stress 0 (advanced/GlassBiometricAdaptation.tsx:749-753). 'Predictive' sorting builds a fake MouseEvent object with document.createElement to record a click (550-574). 'AccessibleDataTable' preset = biometric + spatial audio + achievements, which has nothing to do with accessibility (1336-1351).
target: Single consolidated GlassTable: headless core (TanStack-style) + glass skin from GlassDataGrid.module.css; drop all consciousness variants
justification: A data table is a flagship-grade surface for a premium design system and this file has the right bones (typed columns, mobile card layout, pagination, selection). But it is weighed down by Rules-of-Hooks violations, a dropped ref, keyboard-inaccessible sorting, three competing material sources, dead Tailwind classes, 6k lines of pseudo-AI imports and fake eye-tracking/biometric presets. Rebuild as the one table for the library with controlled state, virtualization option and real a11y; delete the consciousness exports and the four sibling tables.

name: GlassDiffViewer
material_impl: OptimizedGlass overridden inline with hard-coded gradient/border/shadow (199-210, 283-294) duplicated twice; add/remove row colors hard-coded rgba mint/rose (85-100) not tokens. One fallback color is dark slate (219) while others are light - inconsistent.
a11y: Rows have aria-label 'Added line' which replaces the code content for AT (142) - screen reader hears 'Added line' not the code. Sign column aria-hidden. Color + sign used (good).
api: No forwardRef, no style/rest passthrough. `language` prop only sets a data attribute (no highlighting). sideBySide and mode are redundant. Ships default demo strings as left/right defaults (29-31).
fake_complexity: The 'diff' is positional line-by-line comparison, not an LCS/Myers diff (43-83): inserting one line at the top marks every subsequent line as removed+added. 'split' mode just shows raw before/after panels with no change highlighting.
target: Shared CodeSurface primitive + DiffViewer using a real diff algorithm (e.g. jsdiff, pinned) with optional highlighter
justification: The name promises a diff viewer; the algorithm is wrong for any real-world change, and split mode does not show differences. Either implement a real line diff with hunks and split alignment on a shared code-surface primitive, or remove it from the core package.

name: GlassDivider (+ GlassTextDivider, GlassIconDivider)
material_impl: Relies on Tailwind classes not shipped by the library: bg-gradient-to-r with from-transparent/via-primary/40 (gradient stops absent - rg finds no via-primary rule), bg-glass-border/20, shadow-primary/20, animate-shimmer, animate-glow (93-124, 206-212). Default line sizes h-0.5 / w-0.5 / h-1 etc. A 1px hairline gets 'glass-backdrop-blur-sm' (200). Label wrapped in an OptimizedGlass pill (255-270).
motion: Every divider fades in via Motion; useMotionPreference wired. animate-shimmer/animate-glow classes undefined (library has glass-animate-shimmer instead).
a11y: role=separator with aria-orientation; but labelled variant puts content inside role=separator (separator children are presentational) so label text is hidden from some AT.
api: forwardRef via Motion as=div; 6 variants x 5 colors x 3 opacities x 4 animations x 6 spacings - large surface mostly non-functional. Vertical always adds glass-mx-4 regardless of spacing prop.
fake_complexity: Gradient/glow/shimmer variants likely render as nothing/flat because classes are missing.
target: GlassSeparator (layout) with a token hairline + optional label slot
justification: A divider should be a token hairline; this one has a combinatorial prop surface built on missing Tailwind classes, animates on mount, and duplicates GlassSeparator. Merge into one Separator with hairline/label variants.

name: GlassEmptyState
material_impl: OptimizedGlass (subtle). Inline override forces --glass-theme-text: rgba(15,23,42,0.92) dark slate (83) - on the library's default dark glass theme this yields dark text on dark glass unless glass-text-* classes win. Icon well uses glass-bg-white/8 class.
a11y: role=status aria-live=polite on a static empty state (68-69) - announces on mount; heading hard-coded h3. Actions use GlassButton asChild for links (good).
api: forwardRef, className, rest; variant 'compact' mixed with semantic variants; actions as data objects instead of slots. Default copy baked in.
justification: Small, sane, recent component. Fix the forced dark text token, drop the live-region role, add heading-level/slot API, add tests and certification coverage (no screenshot exists), and make tables/kanban reuse it for their empty states.

name: GlassErrorState
material_impl: OptimizedGlass with border="visible" (43) - not a member of the OptimizedGlass border union (src/primitives/OptimizedGlassCore.tsx:60-69), so it falls through to default. Same forced dark --glass-theme-text override (48). Error icon uses glass-text-primary - no danger color at all.
a11y: role=alert + aria-live assertive for error severity - acceptable for a load failure; heading h3 fixed.
api: forwardRef; onRetry; severity only toggles aria-live, not visuals.
target: StateView (empty/error/loading) family sharing one layout, or GlassAlert recipe
justification: Thin component with an invalid primitive prop and no danger styling. Merge with EmptyState/LoadingState into a single state-view component with tone tokens.

name: GlassGanttChart
material_impl: Every task bar is its own OptimizedGlass with backdrop-blur (463-499) inside a glass container - N backdrop-filters for N tasks. Status colors hard-coded hex (244-250); milestone colors hard-coded #70d6ff; many glass-surface-primary/30-style classes.
motion: Motion fadeIn/slideUp/slideRight with per-row stagger delays (index*50/100ms); useMotionPreference wired. Dead runtime class glass-duration-[${...}ms] (470, 518).
a11y: No grid/treegrid/table semantics; task bars are non-focusable divs with mouse-only click/drag (490-499); hierarchy expand button '▼' has no handler or label (731-733); no keyboard alternative for move/resize/progress; milestone info via title attribute only.
api: forwardRef; extensive props but onTaskUpdate, onDependencyCreate, onDependencyDelete, showCriticalPath, showBaseline are declared and never used. Plays sounds on drag (280, 341).
ssr: Uses new Date() during render for today/default range - hydration mismatch risk near midnight/timezone; otherwise safe.
fake_complexity: Partial. Basic bars/dependency lines work, but critical path/baseline/dependency editing are advertised and absent; collapse button is a no-op. Correctness bug: hierarchy indentation applies marginLeft: level*20 to timeline bars (482), shifting child tasks to the wrong dates. 'W' week labels compute Math.ceil(date/7) - week-of-month, not ISO week (370). Each dependency renders a full-size SVG overlay (853-878).
target: Move to an optional @aura-glass/charts or labs package; not core
justification: A Gantt chart is an application, not a design-system component. This one misplaces child task dates, has no keyboard path, advertises unimplemented features and uses per-bar backdrop-filter. Deprecate out of core; if kept, rebuild in a labs package on a canvas/SVG renderer with a single glass container.

name: GlassHeatmap
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell overridden by inline heatmapSurfaceStyle/insetStyle/legendStyle constants with hard-coded rgba (108-135); legend and tooltip are additional OptimizedGlass layers (glass-on-glass-on-glass). Default color scale hex #163047->#25bde3; token colors are resolved by string-matching CSS var names to hard-coded hex (303-307) - token system bypassed.
motion: Reduced motion wired via useMotionPreferenceContext. Every cell gets its own Motion scaleIn with delay (row*cols+col)*10ms (804-819): a 50x50 grid takes 25s to finish appearing and mounts 2,500 Motion wrappers.
a11y: Each cell is a <button> with no accessible name (417-448) - unlabeled buttons; values/tooltip only on mouse hover; zoom buttons '+'/'−' unlabeled (864-875); no table/grid fallback or data summary; y-axis labels use justify-between so they do not align with rows.
api: forwardRef, className/style; accepts matrix or points; selection controlled-only; renderCell/renderTooltip escape hatches good. onWheel preventDefault in React's passive listener does not stop page scroll.
fake_complexity: None in name; zoom is crude.
duplicates: charts/ components (GlassChart etc., not verified in this shard)
target: Charts family on a shared viz layer (single SVG/canvas, tokenized sequential palettes, accessible data table fallback)
justification: Useful concept, but per-cell buttons without names, per-cell Motion staggering, nested glass layers and token-by-string-matching make it neither accessible nor scalable. Redesign within a coherent charts layer.

name: GlassJSONViewer
material_impl: OptimizedGlass then a bespoke inline backdropFilter 'blur(16px) saturate(1.4) brightness(1.08) contrast(1.04)' with hard-coded gradient/border/shadow (5-16) - the clearest case in this shard of bypassing the material system with hand-rolled backdrop-filter.
a11y: Plain <pre>; no label/region; fine but minimal.
api: No forwardRef, no rest/style passthrough. Just JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) - throws on circular structures/BigInt with no guard.
fake_complexity: Named 'Viewer' but has no collapsing, syntax coloring, copy, or search - it is a styled <pre>.
target: Shared CodeSurface/CodeBlock primitive (JSON as a language mode); collapsible tree as optional labs feature
justification: A 78-line styled <pre> with bespoke backdrop-filter and an unsafe stringify. Fold into one code-surface primitive shared with DiffViewer/SchemaViewer.

name: GlassKanbanBoard

stories.notes: Default + CompactCards with stateful onCardMove; realistic content.

tests.notes: Includes contained/compact sizing tests; no drag tests.

material_impl: Three nested OptimizedGlass levels (board > column > card), each also adding 'glass-backdrop-blur-md' (382, 719, 803) - stacked backdrop-filters for every card. Priority/due-date colors via Tailwind bg-green-500/5, bg-red-500, text-red-600 (272-277, 341-346, 519-524) mostly absent from library CSS; board text color hard-coded rgba(248,250,252,0.94) (731).
motion: Motion fadeIn/slideUp with column and card staggering; reduced motion wired via useMotionPreferenceContext. Hover scale-[1.02] arbitrary class not shipped.
a11y: Cards focusable (tabIndex 0, role=article) with Enter/Space to click, but drag is HTML5 DnD only - no keyboard move, no live announcements; touch devices cannot drag (HTML5 DnD). Column add/delete buttons 24px. Headings h1/h2/h3 hard-coded inside a component.
api: forwardRef; many show* booleans (showHeader/showToolbar/showActions/showAddColumn/showAddCard) overlapping; drop position is always 0 or end - no within-column reorder or insertion index. scrollPositions state tracked but never used; virtualized prop unused. Plays sounds via useGlassSound feedback.
ssr: new Date() comparisons in render for due-date coloring; otherwise safe.
fake_complexity: Ships hard-coded demo data: when columns=[] and no emptyState, it renders DEFAULT_KANBAN_COLUMNS ('Sketch hero', 'Wire previews') (126-172, 263-264) - production consumers with an empty board see fake cards. 'virtualized' prop does nothing.
target: Labs/templates package (merge with interactive/GlassKanban); core keeps only Card + sortable list primitives
justification: Board-level app widget with demo data baked in, no keyboard or touch drag, no insertion index, triple stacked backdrop-filters and a duplicate in interactive/. Move out of core into a templates/labs package built on a real accessible DnD layer (e.g. dnd-kit, pinned).

name: NOTE: non-root or internal pieces in this shard
material_impl: Internal: AccordionContent (GlassAccordion.tsx:473), DiffTable/CodePanel (GlassDiffViewer.tsx:115,189), EmptyAction (GlassEmptyState.tsx:32), GlassDataTableInner (GlassDataTable.tsx:1267). GlassAvatarGroup in GlassAvatar.tsx is shadowed at root by interactive/GlassAvatarGroup (src/index.ts:403). Secondary exports (StatusBadge, CountBadge, BadgeGroup, GlassChipGroup, GlassTextDivider, GlassIconDivider, Conscious*/Predictive*/Gaze*/AccessibleDataTable) reach root only if re-exported; root index lines 287-484 export primary names (GlassAnimatedCounter at src/index.ts:368).
justification: Informational record only. Certification screenshots could not be rendered in this session (Read tool returned empty for PNG/JPEG), so visual scores are code-derived; certification JSON shows only the Default story was inspected per component, dark theme only, issuesFound=[] for all, and GlassEmptyState/GlassErrorState have no certification target.
